summary: Betty Jean Shefts specializes in linguistics, Tibetology, and Indology. She studied under Franklin Edgerton (attested 1953–1985) and Geshe Nornang.
Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya works in Buddhist studies. He has served as Dean at Lumbini Buddhist University and Chairman of the Lotus Research Centre, and he taught Surendra Man Bajracharya.

Bhadriraju Krishnamurti was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Pennsylvania (A.M., Ph.D.) and under Murray Barnson Emeneau. He founded and was Professor at Osmania University, and held posts at Andhra University, UC Berkeley, and the University of Hyderabad.

Bhagavan Das was an Indologist and philosopher who earned an M.A. from the University of Calcutta. He founded Banaras Hindu University and Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith, serving as headmaster of the latter and Honorary Secretary at Central Hindu College.
Bhagirath Prasad Tripathi works in Indology and linguistics. He held posts at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1976), including head of the Research Department (attested 1989).

Bhagwan Dash was an Indologist and Tibetologist who studied at the Institute of Teaching and Research in Ayurveda, Tribhuvan University, and the University of Delhi (M.A., PhD). He worked as a bibliographer and cataloguer at the Library of Congress.

Bhagwanlal Indraji was an Indologist and historian-archaeologist who received an honorary doctorate from Leiden University in 1884. He was an Honorary Member of the Royal Asiatic Society, a Fellow at the University of Mumbai, and a member of the Asiatic Society of Mumbai.

Bhajagobinda Ghosh works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. Attested in 1994, he served as Assistant Director at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology and as an Editorial Board Member for the Bulletin of Tibetology.

Bharat Bhushan Vidyalankar is a scholar of linguistics and Indology. He studied at Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya, the University of Delhi, and Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, and has held posts at Kendriya Hindi Sansthan and Sandhaan.
Bhau Daji was an Indologist and historian-archaeologist. He completed his studies at Elphinstone College and Grant Medical College and Sir Jamshedjee Jeejeebhoy Group of Hospitals around 1845–1850.

Bhesh Narayan Dahal works in Indology and history/archaeology. Attested in 2018, he held a post at the National Archives of Nepal and served as an editorial board member for the Documenta Nepalica Book Series.

Bhikkhu Anālayo is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at the University of Ceylon (PhD) and University of Marburg (Habilitation). He has held posts at the University of Hamburg, Sri Lanka International Buddhist Academy, and Dharma Drum Institute of Liberal Arts.

Bhikkhu Bodhi is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Brooklyn College (B.A.) and Claremont Graduate University (Ph.D.). He served as Editor at the Buddhist Publication Society (1984–2002) and president of the Buddhist Association of the United States in 2013.

Bhikkhu Pāsādika is an Indologist, Tibetologist, and Buddhist studies scholar who earned degrees from Magadh University and Punjabi University. His posts include positions at Punjabi University, Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, University of Marburg, and President of Linh Son Buddhist Academy.
Bhikkhu U Dhammissara is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned a Master of Arts at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University, studying under supervisor Sanu Mahatthanadull (attested 2017).

Bhikkhuni Dhammanandā works in Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies (attested 2007), studying under supervisors Tilak Kariyawasam and Daya Edirisinghe, as well as Viên Minh, Toshiichi Endo, and N. A. Jayawickrama.

Bhogilal Sandesara was an Indologist and linguist who studied under Rasiklal Chhotalal Parikh. He served as Director of the Oriental Institute, Vadodara, and was Head of the Gujarati Department at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda.

Bhuwan Lal Joshi was a scholar of Indology who studied at Patna University from around 1948 to 1952. He later held posts at the University of California, Berkeley, and the University of California, Santa Cruz.

Bidia Dandaron was a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied at Saint Petersburg State University under Andrei Vostrikov and under Lubsan Sandan Tsydenov. In 1957, he served as a research fellow at the Institute of Mongolian, Buddhist and Tibetan Studies.

Bihani Sarkar works in Indology and religious studies. She held a post at the University of Hamburg and is attested in 2026 as Senior Lecturer in Comparative Non-Western Thought at Lancaster University.
